candidate_decisions.reason: The focus forms supply exact part, wave, trumpet-blast, horn, and gathering carriers. Their internal relations change mutual surging into a directed complete assembly, and all six nominated branches land.

The exact HFT trace joins focus wave and gathering to 18:100 display and covering. All four branch refs land, with unresolved context branches retained as attributed evidence; the continuation changes the crowd from occluded motion into a disclosed encounter.

The exact HFT trace connects horn and blowing to covered vision, incapacity, and failed hearing in 18:101. All five branches land; the alternative that the incapacity is limited to the earlier life context remains contained.

The exact HFT trace connects focus partitivity and wave motion to acquired alternate guardianship in 18:102. All five branch refs land through focus or attributed context carriers; density is retained as contact, not equated with protection.

The exact HFT trace connects wave and gathering to loss, misdirection, mistaken appraisal, collapsed works, and measure in 18:103-105. All eight branches land as attributed contextual evidence, with the live eschatological-only alternative retained in the boundary.

The exact HFT trace connects partitivity and complete gathering to opposed prepared receptions, sheltered placement, permanence, and non-transfer in 18:102, 18:107, and 18:108. All trace activations are retained, including the repeated reception branch at both destinations.

The exact HFT trace connects human wave-motion and complete gathering to the finite sea and ink comparison and to words that do not end in 18:109. All seven branch refs land, while the possibility that the sea image is independent remains visible.

The exact HFT trace connects gathered plurality to divine oneness, prohibited association, exhaustive negation, and personal action in 18:110. All six branch refs land, and the contextual claim remains bounded to jurisdiction without fusion.

The exact HFT outlier traces focus wave and gathering through the supplied gathering-as-binding and taking coordinates in 18:102. All three branches land; the custodial image is retained as an exploratory undertone, not a lexical replacement.

findings.title: Turbulent Parts Become a Complete Assembly
findings.claim: The focus presents a differentiated multitude moving through one another, then places that turbulent field under a directed trumpet event and an emphatic complete gathering.
findings.mechanism: The two partitive بَعْض forms supply differentiated members, يَمُوجُ supplies their wave-like interpenetration, نُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ supplies a directed event, and جَمَعْنَاهُمْ جَمْعًا closes the sequence as complete assembly.
findings.reader_payoff: The transition becomes perceptible as a change from mutual surge to directed total collection rather than as two unrelated clauses.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains a divine gathering of the people on that day; no full cosmology is assigned to the wave or trumpet images.

epistemic.reason: The reviewed channel source is trusted and the focus supplies exact carriers, but the scene-level integration remains a contextual interpretation rather than a lexical verdict.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The complete assembly gathers parts without erasing their prior differentiation.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is used for partitive differentiation here; no numerical fraction or independent claim about partitioning is added.

findings.title: Occlusion Turns Toward Display
findings.claim: The immediate pericope turns the gathered, mutually occluding multitude toward an exposed encounter: collection makes what was lost in the surge available before a displayed outcome.
findings.mechanism: The focus wave and gathering carriers establish intermixture followed by ordered availability, while 18:100 supplies display and covering at the next step. Their contact changes gathering from mere relocation into preparation for confrontation and disclosure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the immediate continuation matters: the crowd's mutual concealment is followed by an event made available to view.
findings.containment: Only the destination is explicitly displayed, so individuation of every gathered person remains inferred; the focus is not translated as exposure itself.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and context anchors and all HFT roles are supplied, but the display relation is retained as attributed contextual evidence.

findings.reader_payoff: The horn can be perceived as an event that gathers even where normal reception has failed, not merely as an invitation awaiting a listener.
findings.containment: The 18:101 incapacity may concern the earlier failure to receive remembrance, while the final horn could still be heard acoustically; the finding does not settle that alternative.

findings.title: Density Is Not Guardianship

findings.mechanism: The focus partitive and wave carriers create maximal physical contact, while 18:102 supplies acquiring alternate protectors, displacement from the proper authority, and the function of managing an affair. Their contact breaks the equation between being surrounded by others and being effectively protected.
findings.reader_payoff: The crowd image acquires a precise limit: social density can imitate support without producing actual custody or authority.
findings.containment: The surge may remain a literal scene of physical disorder; the social-reliance implication is an attributed contextual reading and does not replace the focus's gathering event.

epistemic.reason: The focus and 18:102 Arabic coordinates and HFT roles are exact, while the distinction between contact and guardianship is an attributed synthesis.

findings.title: Motion Without Progress
findings.claim: The wave can also diagnose kinetic delusion: intense activity that goes nowhere is finally stopped, collected, and exposed to a measure other than its own sense of momentum.
findings.mechanism: The focus wave and gathering carriers meet 18:103-105's loss, lost direction, purposeful striving, mistaken self-appraisal, collapse of works, and measure. The sequence supplies a distinct standard by which motion can be abundant yet yield no progress or weight.
findings.reader_payoff: The turbulent crowd becomes an image of activity whose energy is not proof of arrival, making the later collection legible as an arrest for assessment.
findings.containment: The focus remains a literal eschatological gathering; the kinetic diagnosis is contextual, and the later deeds may remain an independent judgment scene rather than a direct explanation of the crowd.

epistemic.reason: The exact four-ayah HFT trace supplies every coordinate and the changed reading, but its motion-to-deeds integration remains attributed contextual evidence.

findings.title: Gathering as a Common Threshold

The common arrival structure therefore preserves differentiated outcomes.
findings.reader_payoff: The final gathering can be perceived as the end of uncontrolled motion and the beginning of differentiated reception, not as one undivided result.
findings.containment: The focus names the gathering threshold but not the full sorting operation; the opposed destinations and stable residence are supplied by the local pericope and do not erase the focus's ordinary collective scene.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace supplies all focus and context coordinates, while the common-threshold synthesis remains attributed contextual evidence.

findings.title: A Finite Multitude Against Inexhaustible Words
findings.claim: The crowd is overwhelming only from within creaturely scale: it can be completely gathered, while even a sea converted into writing material and replenished cannot bound the divine words.
findings.mechanism: The focus wave makes the multitude ocean-like and the complete gathering makes it totalizable. In 18:109, sea, ink supply, words, and exhaustion form a material sequence in which every reservoir ends before the words do; the shared aquatic field therefore creates a finite-versus-inexhaustible scale contrast.
findings.reader_payoff: The crowd's wave image gains a scale boundary: apparent oceanic magnitude does not make the creaturely multitude uncollectable or make it comparable to inexhaustible divine expression.
findings.containment: The sea image may remain independent rhetoric rather than a deliberate return to the crowd-wave; the finding does not turn the focus into a statement about the sea or exhaustively explain the words.

epistemic.reason: The exact HFT trace supplies the focus and 18:109 coordinates, while the repeated aquatic-field scale comparison remains attributed.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Even sea-like creaturely multitude remains within a total that can be gathered.
branch_activations.boundary: The context branch is unresolved and the focus is not said to name literal water.
